chronicle.text: Thuvuneim came back for food left 5 weeks before, and it was still there.
Tuyanei scratched a mark <o\v> into wood.
Geiyes tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Youzoun gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Nishei drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Suti survived an attack by a bear.
Dakilur went back to a thing they had made a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Tusal struck flint with stone and stared at what happened.
Tusal struck flint with stone and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Thuvuneim tied wood and a wood flake together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Mosol set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
Thuvuneim buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Tuyanei tied a stone flake and a wood flake together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Mezohik tied a club and a blade together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
3 people now take the mark <o\v> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Tuyanei struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
Dougal tied a club and fiber together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
Mezohik found that what Tesek had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
At (5, 36) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Kuzodoum had put in the most.

Years 0-24: population 20 to 29, 25 births. Deaths mostly from illness (10), thirst (3), starvation (3). Average happiness 0.74. Recorded: 6 inventions, 12 firsts, 11 band changes, 6 new exchange partnerships, 5 new settlements.
Shunoyel fed wood to a fire to keep it going: the first kept fire.

A thirsty year: 3 people died for want of water.

A hungry year: 3 people starved.
The mark <o\^> has drifted: it went with shelter, and now, for 3 people, with a grave.
The mark <o\^> has drifted: it went with a grave, and now, for 5 people, with shelter.
Shunoyel took in the orphan Kathas, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.

Years 25-49: population 29 to 15, 16 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (12), illness (10), old age (4). Average happiness 0.69. Recorded: 2 firsts, 1 famines, 10 band changes, 1 new exchange partnerships.
